# Completion checklist: the classic client at 100%

<!-- Generated by tools/completion/build.mjs from docs/coverage.json and tools/completion/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Definition of 100% (Ariel, 21 Nov: "first the client 100% feature complete, then new content").** Four checks, all verifiable, all pre-HOO (no HOO data, assets or code):

1. Every packet of the pinned pre-HOO server and client has a codec and is handled.
2. Every form a player can open in the pinned VB6 client has a screen with every control (classes a/b/c/d below).
3. No open behaviour item: every open issue in arielcamus/ao-client is closed and the reported bugs are fixed.
4. The end-to-end playthrough ([PLAYTHROUGH.md](PLAYTHROUGH.md)) passes against the real server, every step.

| Packets with a codec | 512 | 513 | 1 |
| Screens complete (all controls) | 55 | 58 | 3 (2 partial, 0 not started, 1 covered but missing controls) |

Scope. Packets: the 8 post-pin packets are excluded (docs/COVERAGE.md "post-pin"); "codec" is a registered `[Table.Name]` entry, and the handling check is a name search in apps/web and the bridge. Screens: covered + partial + class a; classes b (account server), c (AO20 extras) and d (dead forms) are out. Playthrough: "passing" means an end-to-end run against the real server; none exists yet (WP-D).

In flight now: PR #54 (feat/prehoo-lock: pins, asset lock, pinned coverage map); branches `fix/char-create`, `fix/walk-into-char`, `fix/codecs-pinned` (no commits yet). Items marked **in flight** are not for new agents.
